messages:
Rohan: hey all, Rohan here (joined today). quick onboarding Q: trying to map who to ping for different ownerships so i don't waste folks' time. a few concrete asks: 1) who is the canonical owner for model routing policies (fallbacks, regional routing)? 2) who signs off on Dedicated capacity requests and quota bumps? 3) what's the page path for production latency spikes vs model quality regressions? and last, any quick links to an owner roster? thanks! :wave:

Tess: welcome Rohan :tada: Owner roster: eng-platform owns routing policies (they publish policy docs). Dedicated capacity approvals go through finance+eng-ops (submit a capacity request; approver is your manager + eng-ops lead).

Miguel: paging flow: oncall-bot pages eng-sre oncall for any >=P2 customer impact. eng-sre triages and will escalate to eng-platform, eng-runtime, or eng-ml depending on cause. Non-customer-facing perf blips can be raised in #eng-runtime during business hours.

Oncall-bot: Incident paging rules: P0/P1 -> eng-sre oncall (pagerduty). P2 with customer impact -> eng-sre + customer-success. All pages include runbook link when available.

Kira: for Private/VPC deployments, access and approval are handled by sales-eng + security (reach out to `sales-eng@redwood.com` and `security@redwood.com`). I keep a mini roster in /handbooks/oncall-roster.md which lists current owners for routing, Dedicated, runtime, and ml.

Rohan: perfect — can someone paste the short access request template for Dedicated capacity or point me to the IT form? will file this afternoon.

Tess: here's a short template you can paste into the IT system:
```
Subject: Dedicated Capacity / Console Access Request - rohan@example.com
Requester: Rohan (rohan@example.com)
Manager: <manager-name>
Team: <team-name>
Reason: Onboarding + need access to monitor routing for feature Z
Requested resources: Dedicated pool access, console read on project <proj>
Expected QPS: 80
Approvers: manager + eng-ops
```

Rohan: filed. thanks everyone — i'll ping if the approver needs anything.
